meta.name: drive-desktop-app
meta.description: Drive and verify an Electron or Tauri desktop app from the inside, including the main-process and Rust IPC calls a browser tool cannot see. Use when a desktop app needs testing, when a feature works in the browser but not in the packaged app, when an IPC or invoke call needs proving, when a desktop screenshot or visual diff is wanted, or when you need a headless run of a desktop UI in CI.

copy.tagline: 从内部驱动并验证桌面应用,把主进程与 IPC 调用一起测通
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果功能在浏览器正常、打包成桌面应用后就失灵。
copy.tagline_en: Drive and verify a desktop app from the inside, testing main-process and IPC calls too
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a feature works in the browser but breaks in the packaged desktop app.

howto.what: Claude 能驱动并检查 Electron 或 Tauri 桌面应用，看到浏览器工具看不到的主进程和 IPC 调用；可执行点击，并在满足网络、元素、控制台条件后才判定结果，还能截图和做视觉对比。
howto.when: 当桌面应用需要测试、功能在浏览器正常但打包后失效，或需要验证 IPC/invoke 调用时接管。

say.text: 这个功能在浏览器里正常，打包后失效了，帮我查一下原因
say.note: 会驱动打包后的应用并给出验证结论

say.text: 给这个 Tauri 应用截个图，和上次的结果做视觉对比
say.note: 需先接好截图步骤，Tauri 要装 crate

howto.what_en: Claude can drive and verify an Electron or Tauri desktop app, seeing main-process and IPC calls a browser tool cannot see. It clicks and settles only when network, element, or console predicates hold, and can screenshot and diff.
howto.when_en: Use when a desktop app needs testing, when a feature works in the browser but not in the packaged app, or when an IPC/invoke call needs proving.

say_en.text: Click the app's archive button; confirm only after ipc://todos:archive succeeds
say_en.note: Waits for that IPC call before judging

say_en.text: A feature works in the browser but fails in the packaged app — find out why
say_en.note: Drives the packaged app and reports a verdict

say_en.text: Screenshot this Tauri app and visually diff it against the last run
say_en.note: Needs the Tauri crate wired first
